beats.title: Entering the forest and meeting Thrin
beats.summary: The party encounters dinosaur-like creatures near the forest edge, then shoots down a stealthy humanoid in the trees. The injured figure is revealed as Thrin, a woodland elf-like being who can speak some Common, wants peace, and asks the group to stop for the night, but they continue toward Mossford.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-17:6f01fc518dea:span:6f01fc518dea:14-14
anchor_quotes: Caelynn and Bonogo approach the large dinosaur-like creatures.
In one quick motion, Bonogo releases an arrow from his short bow.
With some broken words in Common he begs for peace and Stafl casts Healing Word to close the wound.
he wants to leave the forest with us because of some rules that he broke.
the group must keep moving if they are going to save Mossford.

beats.title: Thrin guides the party upward and warns about the forest
beats.summary: Thrin leads the group through handholds and natural bridges into a colder, more humid canopy route. He warns that night is dangerous because of giant flying bugs, and Ephanna's owl reveals they are about halfway through the forest even though dawn is breaking.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-17:6f01fc518dea:span:6f01fc518dea:16-16
anchor_quotes: Thrin shows the group handholds along the trees
It is very humid and the temperature decreases dramatically.
He tells the group that it is too dangerous at night with giant flying bugs that, when killed, will attract even bigger creatures.
Ephanna sends up a magical owl to see over the forest and determine they are about half way through the forest.
the owl is able to see that dawn is breaking.

beats.title: Forest movement, the Broken Crossing, and a careful bypass
beats.summary: Karesmine learns the forest moved after a 'shiny rain' and the party spots a gargantuan wyvern below. They sneak past it, cross into the Broken Crossing using a makeshift rope bridge, then avoid another Thrin-like creature when Thrin insists on stealth over fighting.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-17:6f01fc518dea:span:6f01fc518dea:18-18
anchor_quotes: the forest felt “gross” and needed to move after a “shiny rain” fell over the forest.
among the piles of branches and bodies, is a gargantuan wyvern
The group crosses into the next area of the forest called the Broken Crossing.
Ephanna teleports across the gap and then Baergrom tosses rope to create the bridge.
Thrin motions for everyone to sneak by instead.

beats.title: Crossing the Fallen Spine under aerial threat
beats.summary: The group reaches a treeless area above a swirling pool of water, then follows Thrin down to a side path and into the Fallen Spine. Baergrom slips through the hollow log, triggering alarm as sounds move in the mist and Thrin panics.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c2:session-17:6f01fc518dea:span:6f01fc518dea:20-20
anchor_quotes: there is no canopy above them and a giant swirling pool of water below.
Thrin tells the group to quickly and quietly climb down the trees.
The group sends Thrin out first to cross the giant log.
Baergrom follows, also attempting to be as quiet as possible.
He is able to grab the sides of the walls before falling completely inside the old log.
Karsemine then notices sounds and Thrin starts to panic.

beats.title: Ambush by the apex wyvern and full combat engagement
beats.summary: The tracking wyvern reveals itself as the Apex of the Canopy, or Mother of Broken Branches, and attacks Caelynn. The party shifts from stealth to combat, using Lightning Bolt, Hunter's Mark, Hideous Laughter, Hunger of Hadar, arrows, and axe strikes to force the beast down and sever its tail.

Ephanna casts Hunger of Hadar, creating a terrible sphere of darkness over the creature
Baergrom attacks with three mighty swings of his axe, severing the tail
